name: Blogarama

sources.title: Blogarama - Submit your blog ('free', moderated listings, Premium/Business upsell)
Blogarama - add-a-site endpoint (renders a login wall: email + password required)
Blogarama homepage - 'The Oldest Blog Directory', 163k+ moderated listings

requirements: Blog directory only - the submission unit is a blog (with an RSS feed), not a product landing page
Account required: the 'Submit Your Blog' /add-a-site/ endpoint renders a login form (email + password); register at /members/register first
Free submission is advertised ('Submit your blog for free'); listings are 'active and moderated'
preparation: A real blog with an RSS feed - Blogarama syndicates posts into its directory feed
Registration email and password (activation/resend-activation links exist on the login page)
Blog title, URL, RSS feed URL, category, and description
Optional: their pitch includes 'free advertisement of each of your posts' - posts auto-appear once listed
workflow: Register at https://www.blogarama.com/members/register (login is email-based; activation email may be required - a 'Resend activation' link exists)
Log in, then go to 'Submit Your Blog' (/add-a-site/ or /site-tools/add-your-blog)
Enter blog details (URL/feed, category, description) and submit for moderation
After approval the blog is listed and its posts are syndicated into Blogarama's category feeds
watchFor: Blog-only: submitting a product page or marketing site without a real blog/RSS will fail moderation
Heavy upsell: 'Upgrade To A Business Listing' banners and Premium/Business packages surround the free flow
The site mixes a blog directory with a busy news/aggregator homepage - verify your blog lands in the directory, not just the feed
Account activation by email may be required before the add-site form opens
countsAsLive: The blog has a public listing page on blogarama.com and its latest posts appear in the relevant category feed
unknowns: Whether the free listing requires adding a Blogarama link/badge back to the blog
Whether the outbound link on live listings is dofollow
Premium/Business package pricing (advertised but not price-listed on public pages fetched)
